description: Defines adapter classes for PDCP to RRC communication in a 5G/4G LTE protocol stack, including RX, TX, and control adapters.

classes.name: pdcp_rrc_ue_rx_adapter
classes.description: Adapter for handling incoming PDCP SDUs and protocol/control failures, interfacing with RRC in uplink direction.

classes.name: pdcp_rrc_ue_tx_adapter
classes.description: Adapter for handling outgoing PDCP PDUs, supporting retransmission and discard operations.

classes.name: pdcp_tx_control_rrc_ue_adapter
classes.description: Adapter for handling PDCP transmission control events such as protocol failures and max count reached.

methods.name: on_new_sdu
methods.description: Handles new SDU received from PDCP, stores in internal buffer.

methods.name: on_protocol_failure
methods.description: Handles protocol failure event, logs warning, sets cause.

methods.name: on_integrity_failure
methods.description: Handles integrity failure event, logs warning, sets cause.

methods.name: on_max_count_reached
methods.description: Handles max count reached event, logs warning, sets cause.

methods.name: pop_result
methods.description: Returns stored SDUs or cause if set, resets cause.

methods.name: on_new_pdu
methods.description: Stores new outgoing PDU, marks if retransmission.

methods.name: get_pdcp_pdu
methods.description: Retrieves the stored PDU for transmission.

methods.name: get_failure_cause
methods.description: Returns the current cause of failure.
